name: Architect of Ruin
description: A master builder who tears down the board frame and reconstructs it as a weapon against you.

actions.description: Cracks the board frame, reducing its width
Cracks become Void Channels - balls passing through grant 2x Void Essence
Cracks become hazards - balls touching them gain Cursed
Cracks the board frame every 2 turns
Doubles void essence from crack passages
Balls touching cracks gain Cursed state

weakness_description: Void-touched pegs resist the Architect's frame damage
